chunks.text: Welcome to the Slow English Podcast.
In this podcast, we speak slowly.
Poland is a country in Europe.
Poland has cities, villages, and nature.
The country is modern today, but history is still important.
Rotswaw is one of the most beautiful cities in Poland.
It is not the capital, but it is very special.
Rotswaw is in the west of Poland.
It is near the border with other countries.
The city is built on a river.
The river is called the Odor River.
Water is part of the city.
Because of this, Rotswaw looks unique.
In autumn, leaves are yellow and brown.
In winter, it can be cold.
People wear warm clothes in winter.
Hash hat part five, a city with a long history.
Rotswaw is a very old city.
People lived here many years ago.
The city changed names and rulers.
You can see this history in buildings.
You can feel it in the streets.
Part six, old town and market square.
The heart of Rotswaw is the old town.
The main place is the market square.
In the market square, there is a town hall.
It is very old and beautiful.
The building has details and decorations.
People stop and look at it.
It is one of the symbols of Rotswaw.
Rotswaw is called the city of bridges.
The river goes through the city.
The city feels calm and romantic.
There are many dwarfs in the city.
They are on streets and corners.
They make the city playful and friendly.
People eat soup, meat and potatoes.
They can be sweet or salty.
Daily life is active but not too fast.
The city feels young and modern.
Old buildings and young people mix well.
Part 12, nature, feeling and good parks.
People walk up and relax there.
Nature is part of city life.
Water, trees and sky are close.
Rotswaw is a city of history, bridges, dwarfs and young life.
Thank you for listening to the Slow English Podcast.
See you in the next episode.
